description: Make a hex dump or do the reverse

option.name: -a
tip: Toggle autoskip: a single '*' replaces nul-lines

option.name: -b
tip: Binary digit dump (incompatible with -ps)

option.name: -c
tip: Format <cols> octets per line

option.name: -C
tip: Capitalize variable names in C include file style (-i)

option.name: -d
tip: Show offset in decimal instead of hex

option.name: -e
tip: Little-endian dump (incompatible with -ps, -i, -r)

option.name: -E
tip: Show characters in EBCDIC

option.name: -g
tip: Number of octets per group in normal output

option.name: -h
tip: Print this summary

option.name: -i
tip: Output in C include file style

option.name: -l
tip: Stop after <len> octets

option.name: -n
tip: Set the variable name used in C include output (-i)

option.name: -o
tip: Add <off> to the displayed file position

option.name: -ps
tip: Output in postscript plain hexdump style

option.name: -r
tip: Reverse operation: convert (or patch) hexdump into binary

option.name: -R
tip: Colorize the output

next.name: always
tip: Always colorize

next.name: auto
tip: Colorize when writing to a terminal (default)

next.name: never
tip: Never colorize

option.name: -s
tip: Start at <seek> bytes abs. (or +: rel.) infile offset

option.name: -u
tip: Use upper case hex letters

option.name: -v
tip: Show version: xxd 2025-11-26
